clips.title: The story
paras: At Blackfathom Deeps' entrance, the Drowned Sacellum lies submerged beneath the coast. Brackish saltwater and cavern roots surround its broken stones, now occupied by murlocs and makrura.

You enter the Drowned Sacellum just beyond Blackfathom Deeps' threshold. The chapel once offered quiet worship to Elune, but it has long since collapsed into the sea-swept abyss beneath Ashenvale's coast. Brackish pools swallow its ancient marble flagstones, where starfish cling beneath the cavern ceiling's massive roots. Dark wisps flicker dimly through the gloom, lighting a broken stone path. Careful steps along it lead deeper into the temple complex, toward the Pool of Ask'ar.

Night elf caretakers left the Drowned Sacellum long ago, and shoreline scavengers now hold the ruins. Packs of aggressive murlocs and heavily armored makrura share the murky waters and attack anyone who disturbs their nesting grounds. Darker cultic threats lie deeper in the temple, but these predators guard the first stretch of the underground ruins.
